headline: The classical Suslov body has a complete positive-energy reduced heteroclinic atlas, a singular Poisson measure, and clean periodic SO(3) reconstruction on every permanent-rotation line.

route_a.strongest_failure: Periodic rotations form clean continua rather than an intrinsic arithmetic primitive ledger; the singular reduced bracket supplies no target determinant or same-clock self-adjoint operator.
route_a.strongest_positive: The reduced flow and every permanent-rotation reconstruction are analytic for the full positive-energy family.

theorem.boundaries: If a=b=0, the reduced vector field vanishes on every energy ellipse and every nonzero state reconstructs as a clean SO(3) rotation; H=0 is fixed. One-zero off-diagonal cases remain generic.
theorem.clean_reconstruction: Every nonzero reduced equilibrium has constant body angular velocity and reconstructs as Q(t)=Q0 exp(t hat(omega)), with primitive attitude period 2pi/|omega|. For fixed omega the distinct circles form an SO(3)/SO(2) clean family; energy adds a continuum. These periodic rotations are not omitted or called isolated.
theorem.endpoints: Each energy ellipse has two antipodal permanent rotations ell=0. One is reduced-unstable with exponent +kappa and the other reduced-stable with exponent -kappa; both heteroclinic arcs run from the former to the latter.
theorem.heteroclinics: For q^2=a^2/I1+b^2/I2>0 and H>0, set u=R cos phi, v=R sin phi, R=sqrt(2H), cos delta=(a/sqrt(I1))/q, sin delta=(b/sqrt(I2))/q, kappa=Rq/sqrt(I1 I2). Then phi'=kappa cos(phi-delta); the two branches satisfy sin(phi-delta)=tanh(kappa(t-t0)), cos(phi-delta)=sigma sech(kappa(t-t0)), sigma=+/-1.
theorem.poisson_measure: The reduced bracket is {omega1,omega2}=-ell/(I1 I2). On each ell half-plane, d omega1 d omega2/|ell| is invariant. It is singular at ell=0, and no positive C1 density extends across a nonzero permanent rotation.
theorem.reduction: With ell=a omega1+b omega2, I1 omega1dot=-ell omega2 and I2 omega2dot=ell omega1; H=(I1 omega1^2+I2 omega2^2)/2 is conserved.
theorem.scope: The exact reduced Poisson bracket is a source-local formal hint, not a target quantization or Hilbert--Polya operator.
